meta_description: Unlocked Locksmiths Nottingham. Emergency lockouts, lock repairs, and key cutting. Fast response, fully insured. Call now for rapid assistance.
hero_subhead: Unlocked Locksmiths arrives in under 30 minutes anywhere in Nottingham. Professional, trustworthy, no damage to your property.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to security upgrades, we handle every lock situation with skill and care.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, flat, or office? We'll gain safe entry without damaging your door or frame. Available any time, day or night.

services.title: Lock Repairs and Replacements
services.desc: Broken or faulty locks fixed fast. We supply and fit high-security locks to British Standard — keeping your property genuinely secure.

services.title: Key Cutting and Duplication
services.desc: Precision key cutting for house, office, and vehicle keys. We can also code and programme modern digital keys on site.

services.title: UPVC Door and Window Locks
services.desc: Specialising in uPVC repairs — locks, handles, hinges, and adjustments. Common in Nottingham homes; we know them inside out.

services.title: Burglary Repairs and Security Upgrades
services.desc: After a break-in? We secure your property immediately and recommend stronger locks and reinforcement to prevent repeat incidents.

services.title: Commercial and Landlord Services
services.desc: Rapid lock changes for rental properties, office access control, and master key systems. We work around your tenants' schedules.

about_pullquote: I started this business to help neighbours get back inside, quickly and fairly.
about_para_1: Unlocked Locksmiths has been serving Nottingham homes and businesses for over 8 years. Founded on the principle that a lockout is a genuine emergency, we've built a reputation for arriving fast, solving the problem without fuss, and charging honest prices. Every member of our team is fully trained in non-destructive entry and the latest locking systems.
about_para_2: We're trusted by homeowners, landlords, and lettings agents across Nottingham because we answer our phone at 2am, we don't charge premium rates for night callouts, and we treat your property as if it were our own. Repeat customers choose us because we're reliable, efficient, and we explain what we're doing every step of the way.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday evening with no spare key anywhere. Called Unlocked and the lad was here in 25 minutes. Got me back in without a scratch on the door. Absolute lifesaver. Fair price too, no hidden charges.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our rental property had a broken lock and the tenant couldn't get in. Called first thing Monday and they fitted a new one the same afternoon. Professional, clean, and the tenant was really happy. Definitely using them again.
reviews.author: Patricia L.

reviews.text: Had a dodgy uPVC lock that wouldn't catch properly. Rather than rip it out and replace it, they adjusted and repaired it for a fraction of the cost. Still working perfectly months later. Proper tradesmen, not cowboys.
reviews.author: David K.
